subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue remain a separate WhatsApp 515 finalization tracker after the phone-code login work, or should the active phone-code PR be required to close it with live restart-free recovery proof?
rationale: The remaining work crosses WhatsApp-owned auth recovery, public channel login API shape, persisted credential readiness, and live-device proof; source inspection alone cannot choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep Separate 515 Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a WhatsApp-owned recovery/readiness fix proves that accepted pairing no longer needs an operator gateway restart.

options.title: Require Phone-Code PR To Close It
options.body: Treat the active phone-code PR as responsible for this issue too, but block merge until it includes live proof of restart-free 515 finalization and upgrade-safe credential cleanup.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Auth Readiness Work
options.body: Move the remaining concern under the newer incomplete-credentials/session-readiness issue if maintainers want one canonical WhatsApp auth-state policy tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate 515 Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a WhatsApp-owned recovery/readiness fix proves that accepted pairing no longer needs an operator gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin/channel API, docs, and WhatsApp auth-session boundaries where the history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
